checkpoint.summary: Security planning for #17: use only standard macos-26/macOS-26-intel runners and official existing Actions; builds keep read-only contents, checkout credentials disabled, artifact names include target and exact workflow SHA. Packaging downloads only these same-run artifacts and adds checked SHA-256 manifests. Release remains default-branch CI with existing immutable publication, no new tokens or paid services. Native binaries are unsigned/not notarized; checksums establish integrity, not Apple developer identity. Native CLI demo must use a canonical private temporary root to avoid macOS symlink ancestors. Final complete-diff Security and independent QA still required; this planning is not merge approval.
checkpoint.next: Quality: implement native macOS matrix build/demo/architecture checks and same-source release checksums, required gates, v0.22.16 and English native install guide. Keep Linux/container artifacts for #18 to address separately.
